title: INT ( -4.3 ) is -5: INT rounds down, not toward zero

source.quote: TRUNC(-4.3) returns -4, but INT(-4.3) returns -5 because -5 is the lower number.
source.supports: states the result; Return value: a whole number

source.quote: INT performs a type conversion to an integer and always returns an integer value.
